 This Mfa Is Filed U/S.173(1) Of Mv Act, Praying To
Modify The Judgment And Award Passed By The
Learned Senior Civil Judge And Mact At Holalkere In
Mvc No.251/2017 Dated 20.04.2019 And To Enhance The
Compensation From Rs.39,500/- To Rs.5,00,000/- By
Allowing This Appeal In The Interest Of Equity And
Justice.

This Appeal Coming On For Admission, Through
Physical Hearing/Video Conferencing This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 20.04.2019 passed by the Court of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Holalkere (for short 'the Tribunal'), in MVC No.251/2017, the petitioner (MVC No.251/2017) therein has preferred this appeal.
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as per their ranking before the Tribunal.

3. The case of the petitioner in MVC No.251/2017 is that on 02.11.2016 at about 10.45 p.m., the petitioner was traveling on the motor cycle bearing registration No.KA-17/EU- 8894 from Shettihally to Holalkere Town as a pillion rider.

When they reached near Dogganal Gate at Holalkere Taluk, one bus bearing registration No.KA-16/B-7693 being driven in a rash and negligent manner dashed the motor cycle, because of which, the petitioner sustained grievous injuries.
The Tribunal based on the pleadings and the evidence let in has awarded a sum of Rs.39,500/- along with the interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till deposit.
Not satisfied by the amount awarded by the Tribunal, the petitioner in MVC No.251/2017 has preferred this appeal.

4. After arguing the matter for sometime, both the learned counsel for appellant and respondent No.2 - Insurance Company submitted that they have agreed for enhancement of compensation by another 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) globally, without any interest, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
They have filed a joint memo in this regard and the same is taken on record.
5. Under the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem the request to be just and fair.

Hence the following:
A M Vijaya @ Vijayamma vs S R Girish on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91374215/
2 ORDER i.

sentences.text: Appeal is allowed in part.

ii. The petitioner is entitled to an enhanced compensation of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) globally which shall be over and above what has been awarded by the Tribunal and the said enhanced amount shall not carry any interest and respondent No.2 - Insurance Company shall satisfy the same within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of the judgment and order.
iii) Draw modified award accordingly.
